PKG — 3-Day Package

Zanzibar Essentials 3-Day Package

3 days / 2 nights • All-inclusive itinerary • Return airport transfers included

From $185–$260 per person (2+ travelers)
Book via WhatsApp

Overview

Our signature introduction to Zanzibar. This 3-day package covers the island's must-see highlights: the spice heritage, the marine wonderland of Menai Bay, and the cultural treasures of Stone Town — all in one seamless itinerary.

Detailed Itinerary

1

Day 1 — Culture

Airport arrival transfer (any zone) + Stone Town walking tour with licensed guide + Forodhani night market dinner

2

Day 2 — Marine

Safari Blue dhow day trip to Menai Bay Conservation Area + snorkeling + sandbank lunch

3

Day 3 — Nature

Spice farm tour with lunch + airport departure transfer (any zone)

Inclusions

  • Licensed English-speaking guide throughout
  • All airport transfers (any arrival/departure zone)
  • All entry fees: Stone Town museums, Menai Bay marine conservation ($10), spice farm
  • Snorkel gear, towels, and beach essentials provided
  • Dhow boat, crew, and fuel for Safari Blue
  • Seafood barbecue lunch on sandbank (Day 2)
  • Spice farm lunch with local dishes (Day 3)
  • WhatsApp support throughout your trip

Important Notes

  • Hotels not included — we can arrange partner accommodation at wholesale rates
  • Marine conservation fees included: Menai Bay $10 per non-EAC adult
  • Price assumes 2+ travelers — single supplement applies
  • Book 3+ days in advance during peak season (July–August, December–January)
  • Bring swimwear, hat, reef-safe sunscreen, and a light jacket for evenings
